description.value: Champions Guild Automation: When you use Innate Sorcery, the module offers the crown for its duration: Fly 60 ft (hover); Burning Life Force - once per turn when hit, spend up to CHA modifier Hit Point Dice to reduce the damage (asked); Spell Avoidance - spell saves for half damage deal none on a success and half on a failure. Once per Long Rest, or spend 5 Sorcery Points (asked).

automation.notes: Champions Guild Automation: Crown effects after Innate Sorcery (module).
